# K-Ramie

> A Korean-first warm parchment design system for AI-assisted professional documents. One accent color, serif-led hierarchy tuned for Hangul, editorial whitespace. Fork of Kami (tw93/Kami).

## Author
- Owner: Chano-KR
- Upstream: Tw93 (https://github.com/tw93/Kami)

## What is K-Ramie
K-Ramie is a layout design system for the AI era, optimized for Korean–English bilingual output. Give Claude (or any LLM) a brief, and it produces polished documents: one-pagers, resumes, portfolios, slides, long docs, letters, equity reports, changelogs, blog posts. The system uses a warm parchment canvas (#f5f4ed), ink-blue accent (#1B365D), and a serif chain led by Chosunilbo Myungjo with Pretendard for UI.

## Key Pages
- [Korean showcase](https://k-ramie.vercel.app/): Design system overview with live demos
- [English showcase](https://k-ramie.vercel.app/index-en.html): English variant
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Chano-KR/K-Ramie): Source code and templates

## Install
- Claude Code: `npx skills add Chano-KR/K-Ramie -a claude-code -g -y`
- Claude Code plugin marketplace (v2.1.142+): `/plugin marketplace add Chano-KR/K-Ramie && /plugin install k-ramie@k-ramie`
- Generic agents: `npx skills add Chano-KR/K-Ramie -a '*' -g -y`
- Claude Desktop: download `k-ramie.zip` from GitHub Releases and upload it in Skills settings

## Templates
- One-pager, Letter, Resume, Long document, Portfolio, Slides (Weasy / Keynote / Pitch / Vertical), Equity report, Changelog, Landing page, Blog index / post / series
- 14 diagram types: architecture, flowchart, quadrant, bar chart, line chart, donut chart, state machine, timeline, swimlane, tree, layer stack, venn, candlestick, waterfall

## Korean Typography
- Body serif chain: Chosunilbo Myungjo → Bareun Batang → KoPub World Batang → Noto Serif KR → Source Han Serif K
- UI sans: Pretendard → Noto Sans KR → Apple SD Gothic Neo → Malgun Gothic
- Mono: JetBrains Mono → D2Coding → Fira Code
- Display (opt-in only, not body): Sandoll Gukdae Tteokbokki

## Subsystems
- Slides: presentation deck templates (16:9 keynote, 16:9 pitch, 9:16 vertical) with deterministic per-template spacing and strict text-density limits
- Blog: long-form personal website templates (index, post, series) with KO reading typography
- Video (`remotion-skill/`): drop-in modular layer for existing Remotion harnesses; splits heavy motion (Remotion) vs lightweight scenes (Hyperframes); ffmpeg-stitched hybrid output
